response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, tr.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, tr.ordertypedist), b AS (SELECT tr.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS base FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist) SELECT t.transref, t.ordertypedist, t.avg_short, t.avg_opt, t.avg_short * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.base, 0) AS ratio FROM t LEFT JOIN b ON b.ordertypedist IS t.ordertypedist ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Baseline is the average shortintrt over all matched snapshots in the order type mix (snapshot-weighted, NULLs ignored); a zero or NULL baseline gives a NULL ratio.
Transactions whose ordertypedist is NULL are kept and form their own group (matched via IS), so their baseline is the average over snapshots with NULL mix.
